answer: Problem: Sybil rings share one operator and flood grades. Mechanism: each grader locks 1.2 POA on a ridge-scoped work graph; a spiral of 3 peer attestations must close in 2h, and counterparties must stay above a 14-day horizon of >=7 unique. Cost: 1.2 POA locked. Verification: node rejects graphs under 7 uniques. Failure: collapse or missed spiral window slashes 40% to the pool and freezes the bond 3 epochs.
